item.title: [MSFT Bearish (-0.45)] Microsoft accused of harvesting K-12 students’ personal, behavioral data
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bearish (-0.45)
A new class action lawsuit alleges Microsoft illegally harvests personal and behavioral data from over a million K-12 students in Washington State. The complaint, filed by four school children through their guardian, claims Microsoft's products collect education records, browsing history, app usage, and "telemetric" data without parental consent, creating persistent digital profiles of students. The lawsuit argues that students are "captive participants" in this data harvesting and seeks to represent all Washington K-12 students who have used Microsoft products in school, demanding a jury trial.
